disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to register as required by the act.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fail to register as required by this act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to refund the amount paid for a home improvement within ten days when no substantial work has been performed and more than 45 days have elapsed since the starting date.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fail to refund the amount paid for a home improvement within ten days of either the acceptance and execution of a return receipt for certified mail containing a written request for a refund

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepting a municipal certificate of occupancy or other proof of completion with knowledge that it is false.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Accept a municipal certificate of occupancy or other proof that performance of a home improvement contract is complete or satisfactorily concluded with knowledge that the document or proof is false and the performance is incomplete.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Uttering, offering, or using a false completion certificate to obtain payment or credit.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Utter, offer or use a completion certificate or other proof that a home improvement contract is complete or satisfactorily concluded when the person knows or has reason to know that the document or proof is false

disciplinary_grounds.description: Abandoning or failing to perform, without justification, any home improvement contract.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Abandon or fail to perform, without justification, any home improvement contract or project engaged in or undertaken by a contractor.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Deviating from or disregarding plans or specifications in any material respect without a written change order.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Deviate from or disregard plans or specifications, in any material respect, without a written change order dated and signed by both the contractor and owner

disciplinary_grounds.description: Participating in the financing of a home improvement contract that states a greater monetary obligation than the actual price.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prepare, arrange, accept or participate in the financing of a home improvement contract with knowledge that the home improvement contract states a greater monetary obligation than the actual price of the home improvement.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising or offering to perform a home improvement without intending to accept a contract, perform the work, or charge the advertised price.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertise or offer, by any means, to perform a home improvement if the person does not intend to do any of the following: Accept a home improvement contract. Perform the home improvement. Charge for the home improvement at the price advertised or offered.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Demanding or receiving any payment before the home improvement contract is signed.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Demand or receive any payment for a home improvement before the home improvement contract is signed.

disciplinary_grounds.description: For contracts over $5,000, receiving a deposit in excess of one-third of the contract price.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: for a home improvement contract in which the total price is more than $5,000, receive a deposit in excess of: one-third of the home improvement contract price

disciplinary_grounds.description: As a salesperson, failing to account for or remit to the contractor a payment received in connection with a home improvement.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: While acting as a salesperson, fail to account for or remit to the contractor whom the salesperson represents a payment received in connection with a home improvement.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Changing contractor's business name or identifying information in a fraudulent or deceptive manner without advising the owner in writing within ten days.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: changes the name of the contractor's business, liability insurance information, the contractor's business address or any other identifying information in a fraudulent or deceptive manner likely to cause confusion or misunderstanding without advising the owner in writing within ten days following any such change.

insurance_required.quote: Proof of liability insurance covering personal injury in an amount not less than $50,000 and insurance covering property damage caused by the work of a home improvement contractor in an amount not less than $50,000.

definition_quote.value: Any person who owns and operates a home improvement business or who undertakes, offers to undertake or agrees to perform any home improvement.
definition_quote.quote: "Contractor." Any person who owns and operates a home improvement business or who undertakes, offers to undertake or agrees to perform any home improvement.

methods_authorized.quote: Repair, replacement, remodeling, demolition, removal, renovation, installation, alteration, conversion, modernization, improvement, rehabilitation or sandblasting.

registration_number_required_in_ads.quote: A contractor shall include its registration number in all advertisements distributed within this Commonwealth and on all contracts, estimates and proposals with owners in this Commonwealth.

insurance_personal_injury_minimum_usd.quote: Proof of liability insurance covering personal injury in an amount not less than $50,000

insurance_property_damage_minimum_usd.quote: insurance covering property damage caused by the work of a home improvement contractor in an amount not less than $50,000

self_insurance_permitted.quote: proof of insurance may include information attested to by an applicant that the applicant is self-insured and the bureau shall develop forms for this purpose and make them available to applicants.

contract_must_be_written.quote: No home improvement contract shall be valid or enforceable against an owner unless it: Is in writing and legible and contains the home improvement contractor registration number of the performing contractor.

right_of_rescission_days.quote: shall be permitted to rescind the contract without penalty regardless of where the contract was signed, within three business days of the date of signing.

arbitration_clause_allowed.quote: Nothing in this act shall preclude the court from setting aside an arbitration clause on any basis permitted under Pennsylvania law. If the contract contains an arbitration clause, it shall meet the following requirements or be deemed void by the court upon motion of either party

value: waiver of Federal, State or local health, life, safety or building code requirements
waiver of any right to a jury trial
assignment of or order for payment of wages or other compensation for services

provision that the contractor shall be awarded attorney fees and costs

voidable_contract_clauses.quote: If a home improvement contract contains any of the following clauses, the home improvement contract shall be voidable by the owner: A hold harmless clause. A waiver of Federal, State or local health, life, safety or building code requirements. A confession of judgment clause. A waiver of any right to a jury trial

minimum_annual_revenue_threshold_usd.quote: A person for whom the total cash value of all of that person's home improvements is less than $5,000 during the previous taxable year.

minimum_project_value_usd.quote: for which the total cash price of all work agreed upon between the contractor and owner is more than $500

fraud_offense_defined.quote: A person commits the offense of home improvement fraud if, with intent to defraud or injure anyone or with knowledge that he is facilitating a fraud or injury to be perpetrated by anyone, the actor:

fraud_felony_threshold_usd.quote: a felony of the third degree if the amount involved exceeds $2,000

enhanced_penalty_for_elderly_victims.quote: Where a person commits an offense under subsection (a) and the victim is 60 years of age or older, the grading of the offense shall be one grade higher than specified in paragraphs (1), (2) and (3).

state_preempts_local_registration_fees.quote: Registration under this act shall preclude any requirement of payment of a fee or registration or licensing of any home improvement contractor by any political subdivision.

local_trade_licensing_preserved.quote: This provision does not affect existing licensing standards in effect on the effective date of this act, with respect to electricians and plumbers and other trades, where licensing is conditioned on requirements of testing or possession of certificates obtained through specific training in electricity or plumbing or other trades.

registration_renewal_interval_years.quote: Any registered contractor in this Commonwealth who is registered or licensed as a home improvement contractor in any other state, or political subdivision thereof, shall report this information to the bureau on the initial registration and biennial registration application.

out_of_state_disciplinary_action_reporti.quote: Any disciplinary action taken in such other jurisdiction shall be reported to the bureau on the initial registration application or, if such action occurred subsequent to submission of an initial application, on the biennial registration application or within 90 days of final disposition, whichever is sooner.
